title: Reliability Manager (Remote)
job_description:
If you are currently employed at Smithfield, please log into Workday and submit your application through the Jobs Hub.

Have a seat at our table. When you join Smithfield, you become part of something special – a company that's sustainably feeding people around the world, producing good food the right way with respect for our people, animals, communities and planet. With opportunities across locations and functions, a culture grounded in our Core Four values - gratitude, communication, respect and accountability - and a strong commitment to learning, collaboration, and innovation, Smithfield offers challenging and rewarding careers where you can grow, contribute and make a real impact. Apply Now!

THE VALUE YOU’LL BRING:

The position summary states the general nature and purpose of the job. Overall accountabilities are defined in this section.

This is a remote position with geographic requirements. To effectively support business operations, candidates must reside within 60 miles of a designated company location and be able to travel to assigned facilities as needed. Relocation may be required for candidates who do not currently meet this requirement.

Are you a dynamic, creative engineering professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and loves collaborating with key stakeholders to drive innovation and business growth? If so, it's time to join one of the nation’s top 25 consumer packaged goods companies— Smithfield Foods !

As a member of our Engineering team , you’ll dive into data analysis and design impactful plans to optimize production processes, all while finding innovative ways to eliminate waste and boost efficiency. Your contributions will directly influence the quality and reliability of products from iconic brands like Smithfield, Eckrich, Nathan's Famous , and many more—ensuring we meet the evolving needs of our customers and consumers.

As a Reliability Manager , you’ll take the lead in driving reliability and maintaining equipment and processes essential to smooth plant operations. You’ll develop and implement cutting-edge reliability strategies, champion best practices, and inspire a culture of continuous improvement. Your role will be pivotal in enhancing plant performance, safeguarding operations, and delivering on our commitment to operational excellence. Join us and be at the forefront of shaping the future of manufacturing!

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The below statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. May perform other duties as assigned.

Innovative Reliability & Maintenance Strategy: You'll collaborate with plant reliability teams and cross-functional departments to drive cutting-edge, standardized maintenance strategies for both existing and new equipment programs. Lead the charge in planning, developing, and deploying industry-leading best practices in maintenance management and reliability engineering. Champion key reliability elements like asset health assurance, predictive and preventive maintenance, root cause analysis (RCA), component reliability, and Operator-Driven Reliability, all while ensuring top-tier performance across operations.

Standardizing Excellence Across Facilities: Spearhead the unification of preventive and predictive maintenance strategies, ensuring consistent, high-performance approaches across all Smithfield facilities. Foster a culture of continuous improvement by sharing best practices, solving root causes, and rolling out procedural changes that boost equipment reliability and performance throughout the organization.

Collaboration & Problem-Solving Mastery: Partner with plant engineers, corporate teams, and vendors to tackle engineering challenges, uncover root causes, and drive innovative solutions to fix repetitive equipment failures and other maintenance obstacles. Identify game-changing opportunities for cost savings, from improving equipment reliability to extending parts life and optimizing labor costs, all while elevating the bottom line.

Training, Development & Data-Driven Decisions: Take charge of elevating your team's skill set by identifying training opportunities that foster growth and ensure a high-performance maintenance workforce. Harness the power of CMMS/SAP to transform raw data into actionable insights, performing advanced reliability analysis to keep operations running smoothly. Lead the assessment of asset performance, providing expert guidance on whether to repair or replace equipment, ensuring reliability standards are met for peak operational efficiency.

WHAT WE’RE SEEKING:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Engineering or related filed and 5+ years of experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience, required.

2+ years of experience in a position of leadership to include team development and management, required.

Knowledge of engineering principles and techniques related to food processing and the meat industry.

Proficient in SAP and CMMS.

Proficient in Microsoft Suite products.

Ability to communicate technical ideas and concepts effectively.

Energized by collaboration through travel to other locations. (50% of the time).

OTHER SKILLS THAT MAKE YOU STAND OUT:

Ability to apply sound engineering principles to operational and design issues.

Excellent written and oral communication skills, organizational planning, teamwork, analytical reasoning and adaptability.

Ability to work well with others in fast paced, dynamic environment.

Ability to be respectful, approachable and team oriented while building strong working relationships and a positive work environment.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position may lead a team of engineers and will provide training and guidance to Plant staff, Project Engineers, and Senior Project Engineers.

Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.

Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The physical demands described here are representative of those an employee should possess to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Corporate working environment.

Noise level in the work environment is moderate.

When located in the plant the environment will include wet or humid conditions (non-weather related), extreme cold and heat (non-weather related), working near moving mechanical parts, exposure to fumes or airborne particles, and chemicals.

Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Specific vision includes close vision and ability to adjust focus.

Frequently required to sit, use hands to handle or feel, and talk or hear.

The expected pay range for this position is $105,000 - $140,000 annually.



Smithfield Foods provides pay ranges that reflect its good faith estimate of the salary or hourly wage the company reasonably expects to pay for a position at the time of hire. Individual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, location of the position, the candidate’s qualifications and experience, internal equity, external market pay for comparable positions and budget considerations.
